initial_code.python:
def cyber_ip_valid(s):
    parts = s.split('.')
    if len(parts) != 4: return False
    for p in parts:
        if not p.isdigit(): return False
        if str(int(p)) != p: return False
        if not (0 <= int(p) <= 255): return False
    return True

challenges.title: SPI Frame Payload Parser
challenges.description: Extract payload from an SPI frame list: [Start(0xAA), Len, CMD, payload..., XOR]. Verify start byte and XOR checksum.

initial_code.python:
def embed_spi_frame(frame):
    if len(frame) < 4 or frame[0] != 0xAA: return []
    length = frame[1]
    cmd = frame[2]
    payload = frame[3:-1]
    checksum = frame[-1]
    if len(payload) != length: return []
    xor_sum = cmd
    for p in payload: xor_sum ^= p
    if xor_sum != checksum: return []
    return payload

challenges.title: UART Frame Parity Evaluator
challenges.description: Verify 9-bit UART frame parity validity. Bit 0-7 are data, bit 8 is parity bit. Mode is 'even' or 'odd'. Returns true/false. Return 1 for true and 0 for false (this keeps results consistent across Python and JavaScript).

initial_code.python:
def embed_uart_parity(frame, mode):
    data = frame & 0xFF
    parity_bit = (frame >> 8) & 1
    c = bin(data).count('1')
    expected = 1 if c % 2 != 0 else 0
    if mode == 'even':
        return parity_bit == expected
    return parity_bit != expected

    return [round(x + d * math.cos(theta), 2), round(y + d * math.sin(theta), 2)]

challenges.title: 3R Joint Out-Of-Reach Verifier

initial_code.python:
def robot_ik_check(l1, l2, l3, tx, ty):
    import math
    max_reach = l1 + l2 + l3
    dist = math.sqrt(tx**2 + ty**2)
    return dist <= max_reach
